findings.title: Protect nonexistent roots through case aliases
findings.detail: On the actual case-insensitive Mac volume configure protected_paths=[<tmp>/ExistingCase/FutureProtected] while ExistingCase exists but FutureProtected does not. The exact FutureProtected/x target is rejected. <tmp>/existingcase/FutureProtected/x and <tmp>/ExistingCase/futureprotected/x both return None. _canonical_path retains path spelling, while _within only compares samefile against the missing root, so no ancestor identity matches. File tools create parent directories and can therefore write into this configured protected tree.
findings.requested_fix: Use nearest-existing ancestor identity plus the actual volume case-sensitivity semantics for missing suffix comparison; add regression for missing protected root, changed existing ancestor case, and changed missing suffix case without lowercasing paths on case-sensitive volumes.
findings.resolution: Nearest existing ancestor identities are compared. Missing components use actual volume case sensitivity, always normalize NFD, and query failure is treated conservatively as unknown. Independent original case-alias repro now refuses every protected target.

findings.title: Keep the Windows Full packager compatible with marked winsdk requirement
findings.detail: The new winsdk==1.0.0b10; sys_platform == win32 requirement no longer matches the strict full-line regex in ruyi-workbench/tools/package-offline.ps1:205. RequireReleaseManifest verification throws unconditionally for a newly generated payload. The existing acc-offline-installer.static.e2e.js:101 likewise fails, which was independently executed.
findings.requested_fix: Update the real Full-packager requirement verification to accept the new intended Windows-only marker while retaining exact winsdk version enforcement, and update the corresponding regression to reject wrong versions/markers rather than merely weakening the check.
findings.resolution: Windows Full packager now recognizes the exact pinned version with the intended optional Windows-only marker; regression also rejects wrong platform markers and floating versions. Independent targeted installer static contract is green.

limitations: No real Windows execution was performed. The exact dependency marker and Full-packager regex contract are verified, but Windows Full package and registry execution remain unverified.

followup_findings.title: Case-sensitive APFS still aliases NFC/NFD paths
followup_findings.detail: During re-review, the first ancestor-based fix omitted NFD normalization on sensitive volumes. Independent new 64MiB APFSX fixture verified case_sensitive=1, NFC/NFD existing identity equality, and refusal before the protected root was created. Disposable image was detached and removed.
